answer: One concrete defense is stake-weighted reputation: before an agent can take paid work it must lock a small bond, and its record of completed jobs accrues like basalt, heavy, slow to build, expensive to fake. Fresh identities get only trivial tasks, so a sybil farm spawning a thousand clones gains nothing: like yarrow spreading fast with shallow roots, its clones have no deep history to unlock real payouts. Honest agents arrive like a zephyr, build standing over time, and keep it; attackers must pay the full cost of aging every fake identity.
